jobs.title: Software Engineer (Data Analytics), AI & Data Platforms (AiDP)
jobs.description:
Apple's AI \& Data Platform (AiDP) Data Services organization is seeking a motivated Software Engineer, Data Analytics focused on providing data analytics and search services. Engineers on this team build data processing platforms and develop required tooling for Apple's most critical internet services at massive scale. In AiDP, your work will benefit hundreds of millions of users.  

  

AI \& Data Platforms (AiDP) is IS\&T's engine for AI\-powered innovation. The team brings together data, application development, and machine learning \- including generative AI \- along with data services and customer success functions, to help IS\&T build solutions more efficiently and streamline the adoption and embedding of generative AI across Apple.  

  

**Description**  

  

The AiDP Data Services Analytics team builds data analytics and search capabilities \- provisioning, backup/restore, observability, and self\-service \- spanning OpenSearch, ClickHouse, SingleStore, Couchbase, Apache Doris, Apache Milvus, etc. This role involves supporting data processing and migration efforts across hybrid\-cloud environments (On\-Prem AWS AliCloud) following established Runbooks and adhering to local data residency and regulatory requirements (e.g., China's Cybersecurity Law and PIPL). This role requires good communication and collaboration with infrastructure teams and colleagues across a distributed team.","responsibilities":"Build and run data processing platforms with required monitoring, alerting, and incident management, achieving growing independence  

  

Build working knowledge of data analytics and search concepts (distributed data processing, fast querying, consistency models) across OpenSearch, ClickHouse, Couchbase, Doris, Milvus, etc.  

  

Support performance engineering efforts (profiling, tuning) under guidance from senior team members  

  

Assist with service management across bare metal, virtualized (EC2, AliCloud ECS), and containerized (K8s) style platforms  

  

Execute and support data migration tasks across hybrid clouds, including validation and rollback support  

  

Build understanding of operating systems and datacenter architecture concepts relevant to transactional workloads  

  

Produce and maintain clear documentation \- Runbooks, architecture diagrams, and migration playbook updates  

  

Support compliance with local data residency and regulatory requirements applicable to China\-based infrastructure  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**  

  

Some operational experience with stateful services on Kubernetes  

  

Exposure to database\-as\-a\-service control planes, provisioning APIs, or self\-service tooling  

  

Experience assisting with cross\-cloud / hybrid\-cloud data migrations for transactional systems  

  

Familiarity with observability concepts (SLIs/SLOs), backup, and DR practices for OLTP/distributed\-SQL engines  

  

Solid troubleshooting skills, a resourceful first\-principles approach to problem solving, and good technical writing habits  

  

Contributions to open\-source database projects or internal data\-platform tooling  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**  

  

3\+ years experience in data analytics and/or data search space  

  

Experience and knowledge of Java or Python programming languages  

  

Hands\-on production experience with at least one of the following technologies: Solar, Elastic Search, Iceberg, ClickHouse, Doris and/or Couchbase  

  

Exposure to running infrastructure with reliance on automation tooling, across Datacenter and Cloud architectures (including Alibaba Cloud and/or AWS)  

  

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related work experience  

  

**Pay \& Benefits**  

  

At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $150,400 and $225,300, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.  

  

Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses \- including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits  

  

Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description:
At Orchard, we’re securing America’s food supply by building the AI Farmer that automates our nation’s farms. We are the industry leader, growing rapidly, and backed by more than $25 million from leading investors, including Quiet Capital, Shine Capital, and General Catalyst.

  

Every year, hundreds of billions of dollars in crop value are lost because critical farming decisions are made using incomplete and imprecise data. We’re building the technology to change that.

  

Our AI\-powered camera systems mount to tractors and scan millions of trees, vines, and plants, capturing precise data on yield estimates, fruit size, crop health, disease, and more. We train edge vision AI models that analyze every plant and determine exactly what interventions and treatments it needs. That intelligence flows into FruitScope OS, our farm\-management platform, where growers can understand their crops, make better decisions, and direct operations in the field.

  

Today, Orchard’s technology is trusted by some of our nation’s largest farms. They use our products to grow higher\-quality crops while reducing chemical use and operating costs, helping them farm more profitably and sustainably than ever before.

  

**Our Culture:**
----------------

* **Unshakeable Resilience** – Our customers feed millions of people, and our customers depend on us. We are ultra\-hardworking, never give up, and we do whatever it takes.
* **Always Keep Moving** – We move fast, waste no time, and have an extreme bias towards action. Progress compounds every day, and our impact is measured in decades.
* **Improve Everything** – At 1% success, we save millions of pounds of food from going to waste. If we are 100% successful we will impact the lives of billions of people across the world.
* **Farmers First** – Every team member spends at least a few days in the fields with our farmers each month.
* **No Job Beneath Us** – We’re low ego, own every outcome, and are all working towards the same goal.

  

**The Role:**
=============


Every day, our AI camera systems capture data about millions of individual plants and fruit. You will build software that enables farmers to understand, trust, and use that data to run their operations.


As a Senior Full\-Stack Engineer, you will help build FruitScope OS, the web application that our farmers use to run their farms. You will own major product problems end to end: understanding customer needs, designing technical solutions, building across the stack, shipping to production, and learning directly from customers.


You will utilize your extensive depth of frontend and backend knowledge to invent new solutions to address customer needs. The software you build is how our farmers determine what actions and interventions to take to improve their farms: saving on chemical sprays and labor inputs, while making the farm more profitable and sustainable than ever before.

**What You'll Own:**
--------------------

* Build major FruitScope OS web app features from concept through production.
* Develop for our backend, frontend, UI/UX, and database.
* Create intuitive interfaces that make complex agricultural data actionable across millions of plants and billions of crops.
* Build scalable and efficient backend services, APIs, and data models.
* Work directly with our farmers to understand problems and rapidly improve the product.

**What We Look For:**
---------------------

* Hands on experience building production\-quality web apps at scale.
* Experience with modern frontend, backend, database, and cloud infrastructure (React, Python, PostgreSQL, or Google Cloud is helpful)
* You want to own the development of features end\-to\-end, working across all parts of our product, the full stack, and addressing customer feedback.
* Strong product judgment and the ability to turn ambiguous problems into shipped solutions.
* You are comfortable with a lot of autonomy and want substantial ownership.
* You love to move fast, have a bias toward action, and the ability to learn quickly.
* You are fluent in AI coding tools.

**About The Opportunity:**
--------------------------

* Full\-time role, 5 days a week at our San Francisco, CA office
* Medical, dental, and vision coverage with 100% of employee premiums covered
* We move fast, and sometimes this means staying late or working weekends
* Our team is close\-knit \& highly driven, you’ll work directly with leadership and collaborate across all our teams
* We’re deeply motivated by the impact we’re making – every line of code written or new system built means less food that goes to waste, and more people who are fed


Compensation Range: $150K \- $250K

jobs.title: Software Engineer – Network
jobs.description:
Job details


Engineering


San Francisco, Phoenix


Full\-time


### **Role**


Build the software that moves data through Azora's space\-ground optical network: link control, data plane services, scheduling, and the ground\-side services that turn raw optical downlinks into reliable customer data delivery. You will implement the protocols and services the Network Architect defines – and help shape them with real implementation feedback.


### **Responsibilities**


* Implement networking software for the ground segment: link management, framing/ARQ logic, data ingest pipelines, store\-and\-forward services, and customer delivery APIs.
* Build the pass scheduling and orchestration services that coordinate satellites, ground stations, and weather data in near\-real time.
* Develop telemetry, tracking, and command (TT\&C) software paths, including encrypted command uplink and telemetry processing.
* Write high\-throughput data plane code capable of sustaining multi\-Gbps downlink rates from receiver hardware to storage and network egress.
* Build monitoring, logging, and operational tooling for a distributed, multi\-site network.
* Develop simulation and test harnesses for protocol behavior over fading optical channels (packet loss, burst errors, outages).
* Participate in on\-call support of operational ground stations as the network scales.

### **Required Qualifications**


* BS/MS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.
* 4\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with significant work in networked systems or distributed services.
* Strong skills in at least one of: Go, Rust, C\+\+, or modern Python for backend/network services.
* Solid understanding of TCP/UDP, sockets, serialization, and performance tuning of network services.
* Experience with Linux systems programming and deployment (containers, systemd, CI/CD).

### **Preferred**


* Experience with satellite ground systems, CCSDS protocols, or SDR/communications software.
* High\-performance networking experience (DPDK, io\_uring, kernel bypass, or 10/25/100GbE pipelines).
* Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP), message queues, and time\-series telemetry stacks (Prometheus, InfluxDB, Grafana).
* Exposure to DTN, custom ARQ protocols, or erasure coding for lossy links.

**Location**


This is an onsite/hybrid role based in Tempe, AZ or the Bay Area, CA – hardware work that’s hard to do remotely. Some travel expected for field deployment and vendor/manufacturing visits.


**Benefits:**


* Generous equity
* Competitive healthcare (including options for vision and dental)
* 401(k)
* Unlimited PTO

**EEO \& Reasonable Accommodations**


* *Azora is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.*
* *If you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know by contacting* *info@azora.space*

**Export Control**


To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicants must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful permanent resident (iii) protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3\), or (iv) be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.


**Salary ranges are based on the following criteria:**


* Final salary is based on geographic location, experience, skills, and qualifications.

**About this Company**


Azora is building high\-bandwidth communications infrastructure for environments where fiber can’t reach. This work spans LEO spacecraft constellations, lunar exploration missions, GEO satcom, deployable optical ground for defense, and data centers both on\- and off\-world. To enable rapid global proliferation Azora is developing compact and modular optical terminals small enough to deploy from a backpack, and space terminals that support high speed optical links from LEO out to the Moon.

jobs.description:

### **Role**


Write the software controlling our hardware; including embedded control, drivers, and real\-time applications running on Azora's space terminals and ground stations. You will own the software that talks directly to FPGAs, detectors, lasers, gimbals, and sensors integrated into our flight and ground systems.


### **Responsibilities**


* Develop embedded and real\-time software for flight and ground hardware: device drivers, board support, FPGA register interfaces (AXI/memory\-mapped), and control applications.
* Implement control loops and supervision logic for lasers, fine\-steering mirrors, detectors, thermal systems, and power management.
* Build hardware bring\-up, manufacturing test, and calibration software used across engineering and production units.
* Develop flight software components including fault detection, isolation, and recovery (FDIR), telemetry, and command handling.
* Create hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) test environments and automated regression suites for embedded software.
* Work side\-by\-side with electrical, FPGA, and optical engineers during integration and environmental test campaigns.
* Profile and optimize for determinism, latency, and resource constraints on embedded targets.
* Ability to solve complex problems in challenging field environments.

### **Required Qualifications**


* BS/MS in Computer Science, Computer/Electrical Engineering, or related field.
* 4\+ years of embedded or hardware\-adjacent software experience in C/C\+\+ (and ideally Rust or Python for tooling).
